title: Applied Seller Adjustment
description: Record of one change the seller applied to a live media buy under a seller_adjustment_allowances entry. It is the readback in get_media_buys applied_adjustments[] and its adjustment_id is the notification_id of media_buy.allowance_applied. Each application increments the buy's revision, and the revision history entry carries change_origin seller_allowance, the allowance_id, and the reason. Experimental in AdCP 3.3 (media_buy.seller_adjustment_allowances).

adjustment_id.description: Seller-assigned identifier, unique within the seller's account namespace (it is the notification_id) and stable across re-emissions.

allowance_id.description: The allowance in the accepted commercial_terms that authorized this change.

revision.description: The media buy revision this application created.

reason.description: Why the seller applied it, such as a forecast shortfall.

released_amount.description: budget_release only. Amount removed from the committed budget, in the media buy currency. No longer billable.

previous_budget.description: budget_release only. The purchase budget before this release, in the media buy currency.

resulting_budget.description: budget_release only. The purchase budget after this release. It MUST NOT be below delivered-to-date plus in-flight when applied.

cumulative_released.description: budget_release only. Total released from this purchase so far, including this release; measured against max_release_fraction.

spot_id.description: schedule_shift only. The spot or airing that moved, when the seller tracks one. A moved spot keeps its spot_id with a new scheduled_at; a spot replaced by a different airing links through replaces_spot_id in delivery reporting.

previous_scheduled_at.description: schedule_shift only. The time before the move.

scheduled_at.description: schedule_shift only. The time after the move.

alternate_index.description: schedule_shift only. Position in the allowance's alternates[] that was used.

skipped_alternates.description: schedule_shift only. Earlier alternates that were not used, each with why it was unavailable, so the first-available rule is auditable.
